name: Handshake Job Applier
tagline: Works the Handshake board for you, from account setup to submitted applications
description: Starts by getting your Handshake account in order, then keeps watching the board against the criteria you gave it. When a posting fits, it puts the application through, attaching the CV you already wrote or producing a letter aimed at that particular role. Built for a student working through a lot of listings.
author: fwhittington_24
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
